capabilities.rationale: The clone provides site-isolated local registration, verification, sign-in, sign-out, and Secure Host-only sessions so the modeled member workflows can be exercised without source credentials. Authenticated source pages remain an explicit evidence gap.

The captured forgot-password entry is backed by a site-isolated local verification challenge and generic non-enumerating responses. Codes remain local simulation secrets and no provider delivery is invoked.

Registration and password-reset challenges remain in the local auth outbox, and an approved local-sandbox enrollment atomically enqueues one branded policy-confirmation business-mail job. Offline runs retain all mail as local simulation; REAL_EMAIL_AUTHORIZED=false and no provider delivery is invoked.
A non-payment enrollment is the local order analogue: it binds one deterministic policy number to a quote and is idempotent by quote id.
The frozen quote funnel includes contact checkout. The local contract records synthetic contact, billing frequency, paperless choice, and terms acceptance only.

The candidate adds an explicitly clone-local payment continuation using only opaque local-sandbox scenario IDs. Amount, owner, currency and fingerprint are server-derived; card, bank, token, Stripe-test and live payment inputs remain forbidden.

Quotes, applications, local member profiles, policy state, documents, uploads, claims, rating selections, and enrollments require a site-bound SQLite database with migrations, reset, restart, backup, and concurrency proofs.
